Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was travleing in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Baytown, Texas, when Driver 2 changed lanes from
the right and moved into the space Driver 1 occupied. The vehicles made contact along their sides, and the impact
scraped the rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and crushed the front passenger door, whcih is consistent with the
sideways force described by both drivers. A Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time and was also
present on arrival of officers. Driver 1 reported a knee injury, which is a plausible result of the knee striking the lower
dash or door trim during a collision of this type. Officers reviewed the scene, spoke with independent witnesses, and
examined photographs taken at the location. Each source gave an account matching the sequence of events, and
Driver 2 acknowledged the lane change. Officers found no indication of prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 is
listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
